components.note: Theorem stated (SUP 116-125) with a written composed proof (ANX 108-175) chaining Theorem prenex-normal-form (R 262-282), Skolem equisatisfiability (R 316-430) and the CNF/clause conversion, whose pointwise lemma has its own written proof (ANX 72-104).

Declared input is a first-order L-sentence (SUP 117); every stage NNF -> rectified NNF -> prenex NNF -> universal Skolem sentence -> CNF matrix -> clause set is stated (table rows 1-5 and 7, figure 183-201); open-formula inputs explicitly require a specified closure (SUP 237-239, ANX 174); clause reading defined (SUP 68-79).

Composition written in ANX 109-140 with the signature change L -> L* explicit; NNF/rectification/prenex introduce no nonlogical symbol (ANX 116-117, table rows 1-3); fresh binders chosen outside a finite forbidden set (table row 2, R 125-126); one fresh function symbol per existential position, constants at arity 0 (ANX 123-127, R 291-301, table row 4); CNF/clause step stays in the same expanded signature with no new symbols (ANX 139-140, SUP 96-98, 112, table row 5).

Forward direction (model -> expansion, AC) and reverse direction (S-model -> L-reduct, no choice) stated in the theorem, Skolem theorem clauses 1/2 and the composed proof; formula equivalence asserted only for same-signature steps (NNF, rectification, prenex, CNF matrix) and explicitly denied across Skolemization (SUP 123-124, 154-155, 203-205; R 432-435; ANX 173-174); the clause-set step is same-models via universal closures, not formula-string equivalence (SUP 166-169, 205-206, 215-216).
